findings.message: No R4-test or R4-api runtime evidence exists yet. A grep for R4 under the target found only autodev-probe/mission-input.json. The Sonnet verifier must run the real checks (assertions plus the HTTP fetch) before the task gate. Reproduce with: node $AUTODEV_COMMON/examples/api-check.mjs under the check context for R4.
clamp does not validate min <= max or NaN inputs. This is outside the R4 text and does not affect the acceptance assertions.

The api check's HTTP handler only exercises add and greet, not clamp. The R4-api check therefore proves only the clamp assertions plus a generic HTTP 200 response. This is a limit of the shared adapter and does not block this review.
